# Namco System 1 Enhanced 2.1

The build applies `enhanced.patch` to [jotego/jtcores at 8bc8172](https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/tree/8bc8172993b9b9488cb45ee8a913090fc4d9b143). The official [MiSTer build for shouse](https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/actions/runs/42940934819/job/130262750585) used `jotego/jtcore20@sha256:a0397645aeac483f90718c89e5fd491c4889db6e4202bcba7f7f7770e14beb6b` at `ea0ef4e973a0010cc697090196251c4962846814`. The candidate checks the compiler version inside that image against Quartus Prime Lite 20.1.1 Build 720 and checks all five timing categories before packaging.

The 19 main and 20 alternative MRA definitions are taken from [jtbin at d2274ea](https://github.com/jotego/jtbin/tree/d2274ea43a04af815ef987291aa385abe5324372/mra). Before packaging, `check.py` verifies the SHA-256 of every original, each set name, the cabinet header, button layout and NVRAM declaration. The sole MRA edit when packaging is the RBF reference.

The physical input simulations cover the LLAPI 2P mapping, SNAC readers, per-button three-tap turbo, the Controller Guide and selectable pause credits. `namco_inputs_tb.sv` exercises the production LLAPI mapper, the native four-player input merge, the cartridge's cabinet-selection register and the MCU bus. It checks both players in Beraboh Man against all combinations of jump and attack pressure, both Quester quadrature counters, their strobe, wrap and reversals, and the native P3/P4 inputs and credits for the four-player cabinet used by Face Off and Tank Force 4P. The three-tap gesture applies to buttons. Quester's spinner stays on its original dial input.

The official MiSTer MRAs reserve a 63,552-byte NVRAM transfer, and the release macro declares 2,048 bytes. The [MiSTer arcade loader](https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Main_MiSTer/blob/ac2e102990fd4e3df83809565873db2d25037ecf/support/arcade/mra_loader.cpp#L66-L110) sizes the disk file and transfer from the MRA. The original [memory configuration](https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/8bc8172993b9b9488cb45ee8a913090fc4d9b143/cores/shouse/cfg/mem.yaml) enables restore for the first 2,048 bytes of EEPROM. The other regions contribute to the diagnostic dump. `jtframe mem --nodbg` reports the difference. Both the MRA declaration and the hardware memory layout follow upstream.

For a hardware test, check Beraboh Man's three jump strengths and three attack strengths, Quester's spinner directions, and independent P3/P4 movement, buttons and credits in Face Off or Tank Force 4P. Test credits during pause and the three-tap SNAC shortcut in a two-button game such as Splatterhouse. On the next launch, verify a previously saved operator setting or score on the same MRA.
